summary.text: Larry McBurney is a Democratic state representative who has represented Iowa House District 44 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists McBurney's career experience as an executive director and notes service in the U.S. Air National Guard from 2003 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Larry McBurney was born in Des Moines, Iowa, according to Ballotpedia.
McBurney served in the U.S. Air National Guard from 2003 to 2015 and earned a high school diploma from Des Moines North High School.
McBurney's career experience includes working as an executive director, and he has been affiliated with the Filipino American Society of Iowa.
In the 2025-2026 session McBurney was assigned to the Labor, House Local Government, House Veterans Affairs and House Ways and Means committees.
